rate_religious_exempt.long_name: Proportion of students with a religious vaccination exemption
rate_religious_exempt.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with a religious exemption from one or more required vaccines.
rate_religious_exempt.long_description: Share of assessed school students holding a religious exemption. Reported by states that separate religious exemptions from other non-medical (philosophical or personal-belief) exemptions.
rate_religious_exempt.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had a religious vaccination exemption.

rate_medical_exempt.long_name: Proportion of students with a medical vaccination exemption
rate_medical_exempt.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with a medical exemption from one or more required vaccines.
rate_medical_exempt.long_description: Share of assessed school students with a physician-certified medical exemption from one or more required vaccines, as reported in the state's annual school immunization survey.
rate_medical_exempt.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had a medical vaccination exemption.

rate_full_exempt.long_name: Proportion of students with any vaccination exemption
rate_full_exempt.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with any exemption (medical or non-medical) from vaccination requirements.
rate_full_exempt.long_description: Share of assessed school students with at least one vaccination exemption of any type, combining medical and non-medical exemptions. Where a state reports the categories separately this is their sum; overlap handling depends on what the source publishes.
rate_full_exempt.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had a vaccination exemption of any kind.

ky_school_immunization.name: Kentucky School Immunization Data
ky_school_immunization.organization: Kentucky Cabinet for Health and Family Services
ky_school_immunization.description: County-level school immunization and exemption data from the Kentucky Department for Public Health.
ky_school_immunization.restrictions: Public data published by the source agency; no access restrictions.
